cards.text:
D-SD01/001EN
Chakrabarthi Divine Dragon, Nirvana
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Discard a card from your hand], choose a grade 0 card from your drop, and call it to (RC).
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit and all of your units with the [overDress] ability get [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

D-SD01/002EN
Blaze Maiden, Reiyu
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Chakrabarthi Divine Dragon, Nirvana", [COST][Soul-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Vairina", reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](VC/RC):During the battle this unit attacked, this unit gets [Power] +2000.

D-SD01/003EN
Blaze Maiden, Rino
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Blaze Maiden, Reiyu", search your deck for up to one "Trickstar", call it to (RC), and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](VC/RC):During the battle that this unit attacked, this unit gets [Power] +2000.

D-SD01/004EN
Sunrise Egg
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

D-SD01/005EN
Fire Slash Dragon, Inferno Sword
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](RC):During the battle this unit attacked, this unit gets [Power] +2000.

D-SD01/006EN
Vairina
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[overDress]-"Trickstar" (You may place it by stacking it on the specified unit instead of normal calling it to (RC))
[AUTO](RC):When this unit in the [overDress] state attacks a vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle. Then, [COST][Soul-Blast 2], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.

D-SD01/007EN
Iron Ball Dragon, Ankybowler
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000

Escort Stealth Dragon, Hayashi Kaze
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

D-SD01/009EN
Trickstar
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):This unit cannot be chosen by your opponent's card effects.

D-SD01/010EN
Spiritual King of Determination, Olbaria
Trigger Unit｜ -｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +100 Million until end of turn!

D-SD01/011EN
Blaze Maiden, Zonne
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] Trigger +1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD01/012EN
Blaze Staff Monk, Cho Kuu Sha
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

Blaze Fist Monk, Nikko
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD01/014EN
Blaze Maiden, Rona
Trigger Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

D-SD01/015EN
Sunburst Evolution
Normal Order｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power -｜ Shield -
Play this with [COST][Counter-Blast 1]!
Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. Choose a "Vairina" from your drop, and put it into your hand.
